profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: ‘It is what we know already that often prevents us from learning.’ –Claude Bernard

positions.title: Software Developement Engineer
positions.description:
• Led the launch of subscription services across multiple global markets, resulting in a 15% increase in adoption and a 10% reduction in churn. This involved close collaboration with product teams to define strategy and execute effectively.
• Led the design and development of robust and scalable microservices and APIs to support the subscription platform, ensuring high availability and seamless integration with existing systems. This included defining API contracts, designing data models, and implementing best practices for security and performance.
• Took ownership of the subscription platform's operational health, proactively identifying and resolving issues, implementing robust monitoring and alerting, and driving continuous improvement in stability and performance. This involved collaboration with operations teams to establish SLAs and ensure they were met, reducing the average incident resolution time by 25%.
• Utilized a deep understanding of AWS services (S3, EC2, DynamoDB, Lambda, SQS, SNS) and the AWS SDK to architect and implement solutions that maximized application performance, reliability, and API efficiency. This included optimizing resource utilization and implementing cost-effective solutions, resulting in a 15% reduction in infrastructure costs.
• Designed and implemented internal and external API integrations, significantly enhancing platform flexibility and improving overall system connectivity. This involved working with partner teams to define integration requirements and ensure compatibility, increasing the number of successful API calls by 20%.
• Implemented a comprehensive monitoring and alerting strategy using CloudWatch, creating dynamic dashboards and alarms for proactive detection of performance bottlenecks and system issues. This enabled rapid response to incidents and minimized downtime, ensuring a positive customer experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)

positions.title: NAND Product Development Engineer Graduate Intern
positions.description:
• Quickly ramped up on JSL (JMP), a niche scripting language unfamiliar to most of the team, and delivered key automation solutions.
• Developed a benchmarking script that validated a new tool, improving data processing efficiency by 10x.
• Created a Python-based toggle correlation tool to match datasets across experiments and change Items, improving data analysis accuracy.
• Delivered multiple presentations on tool usage and code implementation, demonstrating strong communication and knowledge-sharing skills.
• Actively engaged with team members across different backgrounds to gain insights and foster collaboration.
• Worked closely with stakeholders to gather feedback before project releases, ensuring alignment with user needs.
• Took the initiative to expand knowledge in semiconductor development and attended product meetings to understand the PDE team’s broader impact.

positions.title: IRT Web Developer Student Assistant
positions.description:
• Assisted the IT department in troubleshooting and resolving technical issues, ensuring smooth system operations across campus.
• Provided support for incident resolution, diagnosing software and hardware problems, and implementing effective solutions to maintain system stability.

positions.title: Computer Science Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Responsible for the instruction of students in CSC15 - Programming Concepts and Methodology.
• Collaborate with lead teachers to recognize the issues students are facing and recommend solutions.
• Assess student performance and evaluate student work.
• Clarify course material or course content for students.

positions.title: Faculty Senate Student Web Assistant
positions.description: Redesigned the website for the faculty senate on campus.

positions.title: Computer Science Grader
positions.description: Graded lab assignments for students enrolled in "Operating System Principles" and "Computer Network and Internets" courses.

positions.title: Student Assistant- President's Office at Sacramento State
positions.description:
• Provide support for tasks associated with the Spring 2020 and Fall 2021 Hornet Launch Schedule for all first-year students at Sacramento State.
• Review students’ academic preparation (college credit, AP scores, placements) vis-à-vis their current course enrollment and specific spring term roadmaps for their respective majors, and any other requirements from student success group affiliations to:
1) help determine course/seat demand projections for spring and fall 2021
2) create course blocks in which to pre-enroll students
3) identify students to place in corresponding course blocks
• Edit course/student blocks as needed as AP/college credit-TCE is received reformatting or creating templates for the fall semester.
• Provide support for pre-enrollment process

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented a perceptual video quality metric to assess video quality during QA testing of set-top box software. Designed a custom dataset to evaluate the effectiveness of the metric.
• Tested and analyzed video quality on set-top boxes using VMAF-based video quality assessment, improving the reliability of video playback testing by 70%
• Gained hands-on experience in video processing techniques, contributing to a proof of concept for improving video quality measurement during high traffic situations.

positions.title: Machine Learning Intern
positions.description: Developed and optimized machine learning models, applied supervised and unsupervised learning techniques, worked on feature engineering, fine-tuned hyperparameters, explored deep learning concepts, and presented findings to enhance model performance and decision-making.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Developed a standalone web application aimed to reduce overcrowding of queues at supermarkets in India while also providing daily sales analysis report to increase revenue profit.

volunteerExperiences.description:
The purpose of this organization is to celebrate and increase awareness of rich Indian culture. The name of the organization is derived from the Sanskrit language meaning culture. The club organizes various events including two festivals: Navratri and Dhuleti. Navratri, the festival of nine nights is a festival held in honor of the divine feminine. It includes dance performance in the form of Garba. Dhuleti is a festival of colors.

Follow us on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/groups/314815045337/

volunteerExperience.description:
The purpose of this organization is to celebrate and increase awareness of rich Indian culture. The name of the organization is derived from the Sanskrit language meaning culture. The club organizes various events including two festivals: Navratri and Dhuleti. Navratri, the festival of nine nights is a festival held in honor of the divine feminine. It includes dance performance in the form of Garba. Dhuleti is a festival of colors.

Follow us on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/groups/314815045337/
